status: accepted bounded locale-byte instruction checkpoint; PHPStan parity goal remains open
contract:
Outcome: remove repeated general byte classification/case-fold native-entry overhead while preserving live LC_CTYPE semantics for all 256 bytes. No workload recognizers, VM/JIT/layout or Unicode changes.
Baseline: clean 083829c6; source b5a1f2e89d6cd52eaad5b75968b1630a767ac4b3a2ac378631c94aadca7d0a3c; PGO adfa468fceeef3408684f949978243bdb5d9294040019d99a8cabcac999dbba3, 72.1651G; default test-fast 7b42626a7e4529457ef31cf3c95d5f4da680cd21cafbd64126b06d23f4a0e6be.
Evidence: current accepted native samples attribute 0.70% to cold native entry. Older separate exact Callgrind profile records 12,267,930 entries / 504,098,672 inclusive instructions: byte caseless equality 9,182,372 / 376,477,252; ranges 2,707,839 / 111,021,399; shorthand 269,707 / 11,847,448; word checks 108,009 / 4,752,396. These are affected budgets, not current savings.
Hypothesis/envelope: fixed thread-local Cell tables built through existing unsafe boundary replace NativeCall construction/cold entry/libc calls by indexed reads. Global atomic generation changes only after successful LC_CTYPE or LC_ALL mutation; threads refresh lazily. Queries, failures, other categories and environment-only changes do not invalidate. Native arguments remain 0..255; no callback during filling; publish generation after full fill. Existing single-VM-thread global locale contract stays unchanged. Non-Linux ASCII and Unicode matching unchanged. No new heap allocation, unsafe block/function, VM ABI or native lowering.
Ownership: sole integrator owns native_process.rs and focused native locale/regex tests; no other active implementation.
Gates: all-byte C classification/fold expectations; invalidation on CTYPE/ALL, no invalidation on query/failure/other category; focused default regex/ctype/setlocale, fmt/unsafe. Two-pair default test-fast phase gate with exact PHP output requires >=0.30% reduction before independently trained 18-input PGO. This exploratory threshold is declared before edits because affected old budget is only 0.45% of test-fast total versus 0.70% of accepted PGO. Final independent PGO requires >=0.50%, exact PHPStan output; default/no-default/all-feature focused gates, all-target check; independent corpus/regex holdout <=1% regression, RSS/code size/cleanup. No selective sample removal. Native x86-64 only, no architecture-specific code change.
Stop: reject semantic drift, new unsafe invariant, ordinary allocation, unbounded cache, early/final/control failure and fully restore accepted source. Parity remains active regardless. Initial private directory creation used an incorrect evidence path and failed before writing source; no measurements affected.

confirmation_control_policy: All six controls are repeated independently with three pairs and a new fixed order seed. The sub-millisecond count control is enlarged from 5,000 to 500,000 matches before any new measurement; first samples remain visible as short-input evidence. PHP validates each enlarged input. This input-size change is reported explicitly and confirmation medians are not combined with first medians. Every valid sample is retained; confirm <=1% instruction/time regressions outside the observed spread. No new PGO or implementation change.
native_scope: x86-64 native evidence only; no architecture-specific lowering or VM ABI change
